description: This file defines the AccountsSubController class, which manages administrative account operations, including viewing logs, generating reports, handling refunds, changing investments, and listing investments within the Goteo project. It contains methods for administrative workflows related to investments and accounts, including interactions with external payment gateways, user assignments, and project-relation management.

classes.name: AccountsSubController
classes.description: Controller class managing administrative account operations for investments and project funding within the Goteo platform.

methods.name: viewerAction
methods.description: Displays logs or cron output based on user input or defaults.

methods.name: reportAction
methods.description: Generates a report of investments for a specific project, including transaction data.

methods.name: cancelInvest
methods.description: Performs refund operations on an investment through external payment gateways, updating logs and dispatching events.

methods.name: refunduserAction
methods.description: Processes a refund to the original user for a specific investment, managing statuses and pools.

methods.name: refundpoolAction
methods.description: Refunds an investment to the pool (monedero virtual) and updates logs.

methods.name: switchpoolAction
methods.description: Toggle the pool (monedero) status before investment execution.

methods.name: converttopoolAction
methods.description: Converts an investment into a pool investment.

methods.name: changeuserAction
methods.description: Changes the user associated with an investment.

methods.name: addAction
methods.description: Creates a manual investment entry, including initiating payment workflow.

methods.name: updateAction
methods.description: Updates the status of an existing investment.

methods.name: solveAction
methods.description: Marks an incident as resolved, refunding or manually adjusting the investment as needed.

methods.name: detailsAction
methods.description: Displays detailed information about a specific investment.

methods.name: switchresignAction
methods.description: Toggle the resign (donation) status of an investment.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Returns a list of investments with filtering options for administrative review.
